description: PHP unit test class that verifies the behavior of ZipStream when honoring file modification times, ensuring that the last-modified timestamp specified for a file remains unchanged after addition to the zip archive.

classes.name: BugHonorFileTimeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for verifying that ZipStream honors the specified file modification time.

methods.name: testHonorsFileTime
methods.description: Test method that creates a zip archive, adds a file with a specified timestamp, and asserts that the timestamp remains unchanged after adding the file.
